en-US.title: Onion Shampoo's original song
en-US.description:
I shot a music video with just one red onion 🧅💜

Do you know what's going viral on TikTok these days?

Apparently, applying onions directly to your hair is the trend.

They say the antioxidants really help improve hair loss.

But I'm a bit hesitant to just stick them on... 🥲

So I went ahead and found it.

Korea's first onion shampoo, Fruited Purple Booster, made with red onions from Muan, Jeollanam-do.

https://shorturl.at/CqFuk

Is this really shampoo? 💜 The appearance alone is a surprise.

I was worried about the onion smell, but that's a surprise too. The fact that it's free of silicone, parabens, sulfates, and artificial colors is also a surprise. I genuinely recommend this to anyone who cares about what they put on their scalp.

#Fruited #PurpleBooster #OnionShampoo #Korea'sFirstOnionShampoo
